Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/service/PasswordRecoveryService.java only.
- Import existing entities/repos: User, UserRepository, PasswordResetToken, PasswordResetTokenRepository, EmailVerificationToken, EmailVerificationTokenRepository.
- Methods:
  * requestPasswordReset(String email): finds user (if exists, generates 6-digit OTP or UUID token, saves PasswordResetToken with 15-min expiry). Always returns void (no email enumeration).
  * resetPassword(String tokenHash, String newPassword): validates token exists, not expired, not used. Updates user.passwordHash with BCrypt hash, marks token isUsed=true, saves user.
  * sendVerificationEmail(Long userId): creates EmailVerificationToken with 24h expiry.
  * verifyEmail(String tokenHash): validates token, sets user.isVerified=true, marks token isUsed=true.
